components.name: Tapered mill shaft
components.function: Need tapered wall/window host, gallery ring, roof/pivot bearing, lattice sail/hub interfaces and garden stair landing. Existing cedar/cream/gold/ivy vocabulary reused; rotation mechanics require later geometry/animation. Meadow flora/hazel; swallows/bees/ladybirds proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated tapered mill shaft matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
